crew.overview: In the post-apocalyptic future, reigning tyrannical supercomputers teleport a cyborg assassin known as the "Terminator" back to 1984 to kill Sarah Connor, whose unborn son is destined to lead insurgents against 21st century mechanical hegemony. Meanwhile, the human-resistance movement dispatches a lone warrior to safeguard Sarah. Can he stop the virtually indestructible killing machine?
crew.title: The Terminator

details.biography:
Jean Paul Ouellette is a film Director, Producer and Writer, that has achieved a certain amount of success, mostly in the H.P. Lovecraft movie adaptation circle with The Unnamable (film) and its sequel The Unnamable II: The Statement of Randolph Carter. He Directed these, wrote them and produced them. Other than being a bit of a hit in the Lovecraft circle, Ouellette has had a hand in many other cinematic/ television created entities, such as James Cameron's The Terminator. He now works mainly for Television but is still contributing to the motion picture industry.
